additional_info.subject: RE: ID0432648-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/T4 314241502012] EmergencyStopButton_SF2 CRM:02889000131
additional_info.body:
Dear Mert Kanneci,
Could you please confirm if there is any external emergency stop Interface connected with the charger.,
Also, please cross verify connections as per Screen shot attached.
Please check below points in charger in Power :
1)  check if there any wire bridge between A & C
2) If not the check if any External Emergency button connected across A & C
3) if found connected , check the Status of Emergency button : pressed or released
4) IF pressed, release the External Emergency button & turn on the charger & check the status
5) if found release , check the wiring connection in External Emergency button: connection should be in NC Contact.
6) Also cross check the wiring connection for  F01-FA12, F06-SF1,F03-QA26
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma.
